title: Jack Rabbit Strawberry Cheesecake E-Liquid Shortfill 100ml
description: Jack Rabbit Vapes' Strawberry Cheesecake shortfill perfectly captures the essence of this classic dessert, blending the sweet, juicy flavour of ripe strawberries with the luxurious creaminess of cheesecake, all atop a buttery, crumbly biscuit base. This e-liquid is a treat for the senses, offering a rich and satisfying dessert experience that's both indulgent and comforting. Each inhalation delivers a delightful burst of strawberry, followed by the smooth, velvety notes of cheesecake and a satisfying biscuit base, creating a multi-layered vape that's hard to put down. Housed in a 120ml bottle, this shortfill contains 100ml of e-liquid, providing space for 2 x 10ml nicotine shots. Mixing in 2 x 10ml, 18mg nicotine shots will produce 120ml of 3mg e-liquid, giving you the flexibility to customize your nicotine strength. Formulated with a 70VG/30PG ratio, it's perfectly suited for sub-ohm vaping, delivering excellent flavour depth and substantial cloud production with high-powered vaping devices. Jack Rabbit Vapes shortfills are the perfect choice for vapers looking to enjoy high-quality, complex dessert flavours at an economical price, with the convenience of adjusting nicotine levels. Ideal for advanced sub-ohm vaping, these e-liquids cater to those who appreciate a deeper, more immersive vaping experience. Manufactured in the UK, Jack Rabbit Vapes is committed to creating premium-quality dessert and fruit blends. Their expertise in flavour blending shines through in every e-liquid, offering vapers a rich, authentic, and unforgettable taste experience. "
